releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.20
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.20 — Mega battle crash fix

- Fixed the crash that could happen after choosing a move while Mega Evolving Serperior.
- Mega Serperior now keeps its form and stats through the battle, then returns to normal when the battle ends.
- To try it, use Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1, give Serperior Serperiorite, open Fight, and press L + R while choosing a move. The Multiplayer Debug tab can grant the stone.
- Mega Serperior is the only Mega in this build. Save normally before testing; live two-player Mega battles still need a test.

### Downloads
- **Unova-Together.exe**: launcher with the built-in update/download feature.
- **Unova-Together-1.0.20-Windows-x64.zip**: portable Windows game runtime.
- **Repair-Launcher.exe**: repair tool for a broken launcher shortcut.
- **Source archive**: source code and notices.
- **SHA256SUMS**: checksums for the downloaded files.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.19
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.19 — Windows startup repair

Version 1.0.18 could show a melonDS error saying the Qt Windows platform plugin
could not be initialized. Its runtime archive contained the Qt libraries but
omitted `platforms/qwindows.dll`. Version 1.0.19 packages the matching Windows
plugin with the emulator, including inside the standalone download. The release
packager now refuses to build a Windows package if that plugin is missing or
invalid, then verifies the archive copy matches the staged runtime.

There are no Mega gameplay changes in this hotfix. Mega Serperior remains the
only playable Mega profile in the public build. See
[`docs/MEGA_EVOLUTION.md`](docs/MEGA_EVOLUTION.md) for its test steps.

Update from the launcher or download the complete Windows x64 ZIP from the
[1.0.19 release page](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/releases/tag/v1.0.19).
If melonDS is still running, close it before launching the updated emulator.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.18 - Mega Serperior test
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.18 — Mega Serperior test

This launcher update keeps Mega Serperior as the only playable Mega Evolution
in the public build. It supports the English Pokémon Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 ROM
(`IREO`) only. Mega Serperior is a custom form for this mod, not an official
form or a feature of the original game.

Give Serperior the Serperiorite reserved item (item slot 113). In battle, open
**Fight** and press **L + R together** at move selection. Mega Evolution uses
the native ChangeForm command, applies to both battle copies, and restores the
saved party record when the battle ends. Each trainer may Mega Evolve once per
battle. If you need the stone, use **Multiplayer → Debug → Serperiorite → Grant
Mega Stone** while idle in the overworld with C-Gear wireless off, then save
normally.

The matching-overlay 1.0.17 battle replay verified form 0→1, Contrary (126),
both battle copies, unchanged max HP and an unchanged saved party record. The
1.0.18 Release checks pass 8/8, and the exact Redux ROM cold-boots with a visible
advancing frame and reads the relocated Mega archive. The one available newer
checkpoint was captured with a local-draft executable, so it is not a valid
cross-build battle replay; the runtime rejected it safely and preserved the
saved party. Please start a fresh battle after updating and test Serperior
there. The replay uses an injected battle-end transition, not a natural
knockout or victory.

Install **Unova Together 1.0.18** and give all co-op players the same build.
Save normally before testing. A live two-emulator Mega battle and failed-peer
recovery still need playtesting. Other Mega profiles remain disabled in the
public executable; local drafts are experimental and not part of this playable
build. The custom Mega Serperior art was supplied for the project, but
its original artist and public reuse terms remain unconfirmed. No ROM, save,
firmware or RAM capture is included.

See the [Mega Evolution guide](docs/MEGA_EVOLUTION.md) and
[release checks](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS_1.0.18.md).

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.17 - Mega Serperior battle test
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.17 — Mega Serperior battle test

This release makes the experimental, battle-only Mega Serperior available for
the supported English Pokémon Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 ROM (`IREO`). This is a
custom form for this mod, not an official form or a feature of the original
game. Other ROMs are not supported by the Mega overlay.

Use a Serperior holding Serperiorite (reserved item slot 113). In battle, open
**Fight** and press **L + R together** at move selection. The change is
temporary: the tested ChangeForm handler updated both active battle copies,
while the saved party record remained unchanged. Each trainer may Mega Evolve
once per battle. If you need the stone, use the Multiplayer panel's **Debug**
tab while idle in the overworld with C-Gear wireless off, then save normally.

The fresh-state regression replay confirmed form 0→1, Contrary (ability 126),
and battle stats changing from `[78, 109, 95, 109, 129]` to
`[103, 131, 128, 120, 151]`. Max HP remained 147 and the saved party record
was unchanged. The client and server battle copies can be sampled at different
points in a turn, so ordinary damage may have reached only one copy at that
instant. The regression also exercised battle-end cleanup; it does not claim
a natural knockout or win was played through.

Install **Unova Together 1.0.17** and give all co-op players the same build.
Save normally before trying the feature. A live two-emulator Mega battle and
its animation or failed-peer recovery still need playtesting. See the
[Mega Evolution guide](docs/MEGA_EVOLUTION.md) and
[release checks](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS_1.0.17.md).

The supplied custom Mega Serperior sprite is included. Its original artist and
public reuse terms remain unconfirmed. No ROMs, saves, firmware, or RAM
captures are included. The other draft Mega forms remain disabled in the
public game and are under local development.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.16 - Mega Serperior battle verification
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.16 — Mega Serperior battle verification

This launcher and emulator update strengthens the experimental Mega Evolution test for the supported English Pokémon Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 ROM (`IREO`). A full-state battle replay now verifies Mega Serperior's native ChangeForm command, battle stats and ability in both battle copies. Launcher and emulator version labels both report **1.0.16**. Existing ROMs and saves need no conversion. No ROMs, saves, firmware or RAM captures are included. releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.15 — Mega Serperior test
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.15 — Mega Serperior test

This launcher and emulator release adds an experimental, battle-only Mega Evolution for Serperior in the supported English Pokémon Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 ROM (`IREO`). It adds the custom Serperiorite stone, Mega stats and typing, battle transformation and restoration, and a paired co-op event path. Open **Fight** and press **L + R** at move selection. The Multiplayer panel's **Debug** tab can grant Serperiorite while the player is idle in the overworld and C-Gear wireless is off.

Focused native and ROM-overlay regressions pass in Debug and Release. Two LAN instances pass the event transport test, and paired in-memory battle tests verify both native handlers. A live two-emulator battle and natural battle-end restoration remain unverified, so treat co-op Mega Evolution as a test feature and save normally before trying it. See [the Mega Evolution test guide](docs/MEGA_EVOLUTION.md).

Launcher and emulator labels both report **1.0.15**. Existing ROMs and saves are kept. No ROMs, saves, firmware or RAM captures are included. Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS; upstream and dependency notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.14 - Smoother LAN hosting
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.14 — Smoother LAN hosting

This full release addresses the intermittent movement hitch reported while hosting a LAN game.

- The LAN socket worker now services a small bounded batch of ENet events on each poll instead of draining a large burst while holding the shared network lock. This shortens lock contention with the emulator's wireless send path.
- Launcher and emulator version labels now both report **1.0.14**. Existing ROMs, saves and settings are kept when updating.

The change targets host-side hitches that can happen without an FPS drop. It has passed the native build and release packaging checks; please test a hosted session with this release to confirm the improvement on your machine. Clients should use the same release and restart their game after updating.

No ROMs, saves, firmware or RAM captures are included. Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Upstream and dependency notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.13
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.13 — Launcher update recovery

This release fixes launcher update blocking and duplicate-game state after an update.

- Updates and repairs install into separate versioned folders, so they can download and stage while a game is open. The running build and its save files remain in place.
- The launcher detects `melonDS.exe` processes by their executable path across legacy and versioned folders for the same install. An unrelated melonDS installation no longer blocks Play or a repair.
- After switching to a new build, Play stays disabled while any game from the previous version of that install is still running, then becomes available once it exits.
- Fixed the local NSBMD writer package initializer used by optional Soaring and battle-scene generation.

Existing ROMs, profiles and saves need no conversion. Keep every player's game build and launcher version matched. No ROMs, saves, firmware or RAM captures are included.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Upstream and dependency notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.12 — Safer Soaring landings
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.12 — Safer Soaring landings

This full release updates the emulator and launcher together. Soaring remains optional, local to the player and disabled by default; enable it in **Settings → Experimental features**.

- Regional flight scenery now fills open areas with deep ocean, context-based forest islets and lightweight visual flyways. Generated scenery is decorative and cannot be landed on.
- The optional **Show Soaring collision data (debug)** setting marks verified ground, blockers, special tiles and the rider's position.
- Landing candidates avoid authored NPC event positions. After a landing, emulator input stays locked until the requested map and tile have loaded and the player's position has settled, preventing NPC dialogue from interrupting the warp. A timeout reports its status and returns control instead of leaving the flight menu stuck.
- Returning to the take-off point now asks for confirmation.
- Flight timing uses fixed simulation steps, and the cached flight frame remains visible during speedup instead of flashing between the field and flight scene.

Soaring still uses verified coordinates from the take-off map matrix. Separate map matrices do not yet share a verified regional transform, and generated scenery does not add collision or landing locations. See [Soaring design and limits](docs/SOARING_DESIGN.md) and [release checks](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS_1.0.12.md).

The Windows x64 ZIP, standalone launcher, repair utility, matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are provided. Update all players to 1.0.12. Existing ROMs and saves need no conversion. No ROMs, saves, firmware or RAM captures are included.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Upstream and dependency notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.11 — Wider Soaring view
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.11 — Wider Soaring view

This full launcher-detectable release packages the next Soaring test step. The flight scene now streams a wider view of the verified Black 2 outdoor matrix, with fog fading distant terrain and a fallback that reduces scene radius in dense areas to stay within the scenery budget.

Enable **Settings → Experimental features → Soaring flight**, then use **Unova → Pokémon → Take flight**. Soaring remains off by default and local to the player. It does not use the Town Map or claim to connect every separate map matrix. Use the visited-spot landing option where available; verified clear ground and return-to-take-off remain the safe landing paths. Unsupported or missing scenery is covered by the cloud sea.

The release includes matching game and launcher version **1.0.11**, the Windows x64 runtime, standalone launcher, repair utility, corresponding GPL source and SHA-256 checksums. Install from launcher **Updates** or download the complete package. Both players should update to the same version. Existing ROMs and saves do not need conversion.

## Validation

The scene worker regression tests cover the wider radius and budget fallback. ROM-backed checks cover route terrain, a neighboring zone and matrix-edge sky. The assertion-enabled native renderer check passed streamed-scene and neighboring-zone landing cases. The sampled 3,072-unit scene rendered 16,076 faces; the 256×192 renderer microbenchmark measured 7.75 ms p95, compared with 7.22 ms for the 2,048-unit sample. These are focused checks, not full-game frame-time guarantees. Please test the expanded flight view, landing and performance in your own game.

The whole region is not yet a connected atlas: separate matrices have no verified shared coordinates, and some model backs or unsupported props may be missing. Soaring stays experimental. No ROMs, firmware, saves or private captures are included.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Upstream and dependency notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.10 - Smooth movement and shiny followers
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.10 — Follower colours and smooth movement

- Removes synchronous multiplayer polling and full-RAM follower copies from the rendering thread. Requests coalesce while the emulator is busy, preventing polling backlogs and frame-delivery stalls.
- Keeps the last verified follower through temporary party-read failures while the owned field remains valid. Battles, unloading, party changes, eggs and fainted leads still update visibility.
- Bobs the complete follower sprite at pixel-aligned offsets instead of stretching its height.
- Detects the loaded game's verified native shiny threshold. Shiny Audino and other followers use Redux's increased shiny odds, while the original game's rule remains supported.
- Hosted relay startup uses the current shared launcher executable, preserving follower shiny and gender metadata.
- Cleanup detects the shared launcher, bootstrap and repair utility as running installations.

The author confirmed smooth walking/running, idle followers remaining visible, bobbing and shiny Audino in the local gameplay build. Automated decoder, renderer, polling, relay and updater checks passed. This does not claim every species or network configuration has received a new two-PC playtest.

Install through launcher Updates. Restart the game and hosted relay after updating; both players should use the same release. Launcher and emulator report 1.0.10. Saves, ROMs and settings are preserved by the updater.

Includes the Windows runtime, matching GPL source, standalone installer, repair utility and SHA-256 checksums. No ROM, firmware, save or private RAM capture is included. Original contributions by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing, built on melonDS; attribution and dependency notices are preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.9 - Client launcher migration
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.9 — Client launcher migration

Fixes the remaining case where a client's usual launcher shortcut keeps opening 1.0.5 after updating the game package.

- **Repair-Launcher.exe** migrates the original shared `Pokemon Together.exe` entry point into a small permanent bootstrap. Existing shortcuts keep the same target. The bootstrap reads the active update slot and opens its current shared launcher with the same installation/profile home.
- The original executable is backed up. Migration preserves game files, ROMs, profiles, saves and backups. If Windows locks the old launcher, repair asks you to close its window and retries; it never terminates the game.
- New launchers remember their original entry point and schedule this migration after an update. The standalone installer provisions a permanent entry in its existing data home. Future updates are followed without repairing the shortcut again.
- The repaired entry can follow consecutive newer releases without being replaced on every update. Updated slot executables cannot be mistaken for the old entry, and failed replacement restores the original executable and home mapping.

## Existing clients running launcher 1.0.5

1. Install the game update through **Updates** first. The repair supports an installed 1.0.8 or newer package.
2. Download and run **Repair-Launcher.exe** below. Select the **old Pokemon Together.exe used by your usual shortcut**, not the executable inside `.updates/versions`.
3. If asked, select your original Unova installation folder containing `.updates` or `builds`. Close the old launcher window if repair asks, then use your usual shortcut.

This is a one-time migration. Old 1.0.5 code cannot automatically run a repair it does not contain; installing the game package alone does not replace its external launcher. Fresh installations and future updates from the migrated entry use the new route.

The package includes the companion changes, stable **Settings → Following Pokémon** controls and optional experimental flight shortcut from the previous release. Gameplay is unchanged; native resource/credit labels advance to 1.0.9. Full free-flight Soaring remains unfinished.

Windows runtime, matching GPL source, standalone installer, repair utility and SHA-256 checksums are provided. No ROM, firmware, save or RAM capture is bundled. Original contributions by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS; dependency notices are preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.8 - Launcher update fix
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.8 — Launcher update fix

Fixes the case where installing a mod update showed the new release number while reopening the old shared launcher.

- Updates restart into the installed Pokémon Together launcher. Opening an earlier compatible hub forwards to a newer installed hub, preserving the same profile/save home and mod library.
- The Updates page and footer read the running launcher's embedded build metadata. Windows file/product versions and packaged launcher metadata come from the requested build version.
- Handoff rejects older launchers, legacy per-mod launchers and invalid metadata. Equal versions do not loop on startup. A failed handoff leaves the current launcher available.
- Portable launchers use their own installation folder. Shared shortcuts and update handoffs pass the original home explicitly, avoiding an unrelated hardcoded drive path.
- Corrected the emulator's version/credit labels. Gameplay is unchanged from 1.0.7, including the optional experimental native-Fly shortcut; ORAS-style free-flight Soaring remains unfinished.

## Upgrading a launcher older than 1.0.8

Older shared launchers cannot apply this restart fix to their already-running code. After installing 1.0.8 through Updates, close the launcher and run **launcher/Pokemon Together.exe** inside the new `.updates/versions/1.0.8/Unova-Together` folder with `--home` pointing to your original installation. A new portable installation or the standalone download also opens the corrected launcher. Keep the same home to retain profiles and backups. Future updates from this launcher switch automatically.

The release includes the Windows runtime, matching GPL source, standalone launcher and SHA-256 manifest. No ROM, firmware, save or RAM capture is distributed. Original Unova Together contributions by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS; upstream/dependency notices remain included.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.7
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.7

This release adds a searchable Black 2 / Redux practice trainer browser and a launcher-gated flight shortcut. Both build on the loaded game rather than bundling ROM content.

## New

- Search the ROM-backed practice trainer list by trainer name or class. The browser shows party size and level range before starting a no-reward practice battle. Story co-op remains limited to its existing supported trainer set.
- **Settings → Experimental features → Soaring flight** enables **Unova → Pokémon → Take flight**. It opens the native party menu; the game still controls Fly eligibility, destinations and landing.
- Development documentation now describes the next stage for an ORAS-inspired free-flight scene. Free-roaming Soaring is not in this preview.

## Notes

The trainer browser and flight shortcut remain development features. The native Windows build and launcher were compiled and packaged from the matching source. This upload does not claim a live ROM playthrough or two-computer co-op playtest of the new trainer browser or flight shortcut. Use copied saves while evaluating development features.

Each player supplies their own supported ROM and save. No ROM, firmware, save, or RAM capture is included. Unova Together's original contributions are by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**; melonDS and dependency licenses and notices are retained.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.6 - Companion interactions
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.6

Full release by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing, based on melonDS 1.1.

Companion interactions now offer ten choices: Talk, Pet, Play, Praise, Tell a story, Ask about today, Sit together, Show a trick, Tell a joke and Sing together. Each choice has four rotating lines across five friendship bands. The lead Pokémon's nickname, HP, friendship and true Gen 5 nature shape the response; nature is shown through subtle behavior instead of being named.

Reactions add question marks, exclamation marks, hearts, stars, musical notes and ellipses, with brief peeking, swaying, hopping, spinning or running motions. Standing follower sprites with no natural idle movement now bob gently while their feet stay grounded.

Hold **R** and press **A** while facing a still follower to open the menu. A by itself remains available to advance game text, avoiding the dialogue softlock. Tapping or clicking the follower also opens the menu. Interactions are cosmetic and read-only: they do not change friendship, HP, items, or saves.

The focused production-code matrix covers 5,000 dialogue and cue combinations across all 25 nature values, five friendship bands, ten actions and four variations. It also checks all 649 supported species, field eligibility, menu/input gating and safe A-button forwarding. The full Windows emulator build and the packaged standalone launcher's isolated startup self-test passed. No ROM, firmware or save is included.

See [companion interaction instructions](docs/COMPANIONS_AND_SOARING.md) and [release checks](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS_1.0.6.md).

releases.name: Pokemon Together mod library launcher
releases.body:
Pokemon Together now opens a shared mod library on every launch, with separate
Unova and Pokemon X pages. The idle status line is blank and copy is shortened.

Extract the Windows launcher overlay into your existing Unova Together folder and
run Start Pokemon Together.cmd. Unova's runtime, saves and update policy stay with
Unova. Pokemon X requires its separately prepared prototype; its gameplay has not
been rebuilt yet. ROMs, saves, firmware and room credentials are excluded.

Validation: 29 UI/routing tests, frozen launcher self-test, SHA-256 verified package,
ZIP integrity, minimum-window keyboard checks, and strict frontend design audit.
Matching launcher source and checksums are included. Original Unova contributions
are by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing, with upstream credits and licenses preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.5 - 1.25x solo XP
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.5

Full release by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing, based on melonDS 1.1.

Solo battle XP is now **1.25×**, reduced from 1.65×, for supported English Black 2 and Redux profiles. The launcher progression calculator uses the same multiplier. Already earned XP, saves and level thresholds are unchanged. Co-op XP suppression remains unchanged.

Fractional awards round down and the native 100,000 XP award cap remains. At this rate, solo XP can compensate for approximately 20% of the original XP budget being missed in co-op. Actual levels depend on battle participation.

Compiled production-dispatch checks passed against genuine Redux and English Black 2 overlays, including rounding, award limits, unchanged EVs/flags, co-op zero rewards and invalid-context rejection. These are dispatch checks; a new end-to-end battle was not performed for this release.

Includes the launcher, modified emulator, matching GPL source and checksums. No ROMs, firmware or saves are distributed. The experimental HeartGold port is not enabled in this release. Restart the game to apply the new multiplier.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.4 - Installation storage cleanup
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.4 — Installation storage cleanup

Full release: launcher 1.0.4 with the unchanged modified melonDS 1.0.2 runtime, based on melonDS 1.1. Download Unova-Together.exe or the Windows ZIP. Existing users can install through launcher Updates.

## Changes

- Added **Clean old installations** to launcher Tools, with recovered-space feedback.
- Automatic startup cleanup keeps the active installation, one rollback build and all running builds. Older verified package files are removed; saves, ROMs, backups, custom files and modified files are preserved.
- Added an installation file receipt so future cleanup can identify packaged files safely. Legacy cleanup uses existing runtime checksum records and matching launcher binaries, retaining unknown files.
- Reuses identical executable/library files through hardlinks when supported. Changed files and writable configuration are separate; unsupported hardlinks leave normal copies intact.
- Older standalone EXEs now use an already newer active installation without unpacking an unused older bundle.
- Records the previous active build for rollback retention. Installation and cleanup share the same lock.

Updates still download a complete checksum-verified release ZIP; this release reduces retained disk usage, not network download size. Small metadata folders and preserved user files may remain for older builds. Older standalone launchers require their launcher sentinel file to delegate to the current installation, so cleanup retains it.

## Verification

Nine storage tests cover retention, save/custom-file preservation, running builds, modified binaries, malformed paths, Windows junctions, process-check failure, hardlink reuse and copy fallback. 21 native UI tests include the working cleanup button; 13 updater and six standalone installer tests pass. Frozen launcher, standalone installation, package integrity, matching source and uploaded digests are checked before/after publication.

The emulator executable is byte-identical to release 1.0.2; existing gameplay limitations remain. No ROMs, saves, firmware or private settings are distributed. Original contributions by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, with melonDS and dependency attribution preserved. Matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.3 - Simpler saves and Gen 5 tools
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.3 — Simpler saves and Gen 5 tools

A full release with launcher 1.0.3 and the previously verified modified melonDS 1.0.2 runtime, based on melonDS 1.1. Emulator gameplay is unchanged, including 1.65× solo XP compensation.

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract **Unova-Together-1.0.3-Windows-x64.zip** and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Existing players can install through launcher Updates. Existing profile settings, ROMs, saves and backups are retained.

## Changes

- **Games & saves** replaces the profile wording. Play shows the active slot and a Manage saves button.
- Slot names save automatically. New slots reuse the selected ROM with separate save folders. Advanced folder settings and slot removal are tucked away.
- **Back up now** and **Restore backup** share one page. Backups have readable dates and reasons; current files are backed up before restore.
- Added `.save` and numbered instance `.save` support alongside `.sav` and `.dsv`. Contents are preserved without conversion; melonDS normally uses `.sav`.
- Added read-only English Black 2 ROM/XP-hook checks, a checksum-verified party save comparison and a Redux Challenge XP-budget calculator using the existing 1.65× multiplier.

## Verification and limits

20 native UI tests, 15 launcher-service tests and 6 installer tests passed. Real Redux save copies were backed up and restored through launcher controls under all four tested filenames (`.save`, `.2.save`, `.sav`, `.dsv`), byte for byte. The replaced saves were preserved and another ROM's save was untouched. A restored `.save` payload, copied to melonDS's normal `.sav` filename, passed normal boot without a save state: Servine retained level 20 and 5,951 XP, and the Cheren badge remained present. Frozen launcher and standalone installer smoke tests passed, including the packaged ROM, save and progression tools.

ROM checks cover English Black 2 identity and the XP hook, not every multiplayer feature or edited asset. The calculator requires the reviewed Redux Complete 1.4.1 ROM and reports XP-budget equivalents, not playthrough predictions. Save comparison checks party blocks and Pokémon records, not every save block; differing banks are shown without guessing which is latest.

Previously documented multiplayer edge cases and physical two-PC/WAN limitations remain. The emulator executable is byte-identical to release 1.0.2. See docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md and docs/LAUNCHER_GEN5_TOOLS.md.

Complete Windows runtime, matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, firmware, saves or private settings are distributed. Original contributions by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**; melonDS and dependency attribution is preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.2 - Solo XP compensation
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.2 — Solo XP compensation

Launcher 1.0.2 and modified melonDS 1.0.2, based on melonDS 1.1. This full release adds **1.65× solo battle XP** to help compensate for XP suppressed in co-op.

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract **Unova-Together-1.0.2-Windows-x64.zip** and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Existing players can use launcher Updates. Update both players; existing ROMs and saves need no conversion.

## Changes

- Newly earned solo battle XP is multiplied by 1.65 after the game calculates level scaling, XP sharing, traded bonuses and Lucky Egg bonuses.
- Fractional XP rounds down per Pokémon; the native 100,000 XP per-award limit remains in force.
- Existing accumulated XP, reward flags and EV rewards are unchanged. Co-op XP remains suppressed: zero rewards stay zero.
- Verified ROM identities, native instruction fingerprints and reward bounds protect unsupported contexts.
- Added reproducible production-dispatch tests, a disposable solo battle runner and the selected Redux Challenge XP-budget calculation.

## Verification and limits

Genuine solo Cheren victories on disposable saves awarded the badge and applied actual party XP: Servine gained **807 XP** with the boost versus **498 XP** normally. The measured total was 62.05% higher; the earlier level-up affects later Generation V rewards, and per-award rounding applies. The reserve Pokémon received no XP. The fixture used boosted combat stats and the interpreter; this does not validate normal difficulty or an end-to-end JIT battle.

**Normal save/reload of the boosted result remains unverified.** Automated post-battle save inputs did not write either result to disk; this is recorded as a failed verification step, separate from the completed battles. No save/reload pass is claimed. See **docs/XP_COMPENSATION_BATTLE_TEST.md**.

The previously documented Practice completion issue under simulated latency remains unfixed. Physical two-PC/WAN reliability, full Fly travel and relearned-move save/reload are not newly verified. See **docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md** and the maintenance review.

The complete Windows runtime, matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, firmware, user saves or private settings are distributed. Unova Together's original contributions are by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**; melonDS and dependency attribution is preserved.

## Subsequent save/reload verification — 11 October 2026

After publication, the same 1.0.2 emulator completed another genuine solo Cheren battle, saved Servine at **5,951 XP / level 20** and the badge through the game UI, and reloaded the same result in a fresh process without a savestate. PKHeX independently verified the written data and checksums. This closes the targeted solo XP persistence gap described above; JIT and full-playthrough behavior remain unverified. See [the follow-up evidence](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/XP_COMPENSATION_BATTLE_TEST.md). Release binaries, corresponding source archives and checksums are unchanged.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.1 - Maintenance release
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.1 — Maintenance release

Launcher 1.0.1 and modified melonDS 1.0.1, based on melonDS 1.1. This full release packages the post-1.0.0 maintenance review, improved verification tools and current known limitations. Gameplay behavior is unchanged from 1.0.0.

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract **Unova-Together-1.0.1-Windows-x64.zip** and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Existing players can use launcher Updates. Update both players; existing saves and ROMs need no conversion.

## Maintenance changes

- Cancellation/retry verification now independently boots both radios instead of cloning savestate wireless state.
- Added a guest-process-loss recovery check and clearer relay/latency evidence names.
- Added native touch-based NPC move selection and a strict save-input completion check.
- HM verification accepts an explicit matching ROM; checks passed with JIT enabled and disabled.
- Included the maintenance review and reproducible verification sources.

## Verification and limits

Local independent-process cancellation/retry passed, including the encrypted UDP relay. Guest loss restored the host checkpoint and released battle allocations. A shared Cheren victory awarded the badge on both games, and separate fresh normal boots verified both saved awards. Saved EXP, levels, moves, IVs and EVs were preserved. This NPC test used disposable boosted combat stats; it does not validate normal difficulty.

Co-op XP remains disabled. A simulated 100 ms round trip in Practice exposed asymmetric completion: one peer finished and the other rolled back. That issue is documented and remains unfixed. Physical two-PC/WAN reliability, complete Fly travel and independent save/reload of relearned moves are not newly verified. See **docs/MAINTENANCE_REVIEW_2026-10-11.md** and **docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md**.

The complete Windows runtime, matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, firmware, user saves or private settings are distributed. Unova Together's original contributions are by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**; melonDS and dependency notices are preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.0 - Full release
releases.body:
# Unova Together 1.0.0 — Full release

The feature-complete Windows release of Unova Together, including **launcher 1.0.0** and **modified melonDS 1.0.0**, based on upstream melonDS 1.1.

## Play

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract **Unova-Together-1.0.0-Windows-x64.zip** and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Select your own supported Black 2 or Blaze Black 2 Redux ROM and press Play. Existing players can install this version through launcher Updates. Update every player and restart the presence relay.

## Included features

- Shared overworld exploration, teammate locations and joining maps.
- Item offers, direct party Pokémon trades and friendly player battles.
- Co-op trainer encounters, Solo/Co-op switching and practice rematches, with independent parties and story saves.
- Directional following Pokémon for all 649 base species and optional companion interactions.
- IV/EV viewing, seasonal encounter finder, free level-up move relearning and field HMs without learned battle move slots.
- Custom camera and optional nearby battle scenery generated locally from your ROM.
- Launcher profiles, LAN Host/Join/Retry, remembered connections, controller navigation, music, emulator settings and optional cheats.
- Save backups and restore, troubleshooting reports, verified updates and installation repair.

## Final polish

Both applications identify as 1.0.0. The launcher uses release wording, current in-game menu paths, a complete feature list and bundled 1.0.0 news. Setup and feature guides now describe the current build. The obsolete flight-preview instructions are removed: that prototype is absent from the current feature set. Upstream melonDS attribution and all project/dependency licenses are retained.

## Known limits

Co-op experience remains disabled to prevent desynchronisation. Saves and story progress remain independent; not every special trainer script has been verified. Keep fast-forward and C-Gear wireless off during native multiplayer. Interrupted battles may require returning to the field and recreating LAN; recovery can discard the interrupted battle's progress.

Tailscale is available for different networks. The optional UDP bridge remains experimental and requires your group's server and Python; there is no bundled public server. Nearby battle scenery and companion interactions remain optional. Companion interactions do not change friendship or HP. The encounter finder covers ordinary encounter tables, excluding gifts, scripted legendaries and Hidden Grottos. Direct Pokémon trades exclude eggs, held Mail and native trade evolutions; use the Union Room for those cases.

See [player guide](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/PLAYER_GUIDE.md), [known limits](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md) and the included release checks for validation details. A full release does not imply every ROM hack, network or special event has been tested.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**. Playtesters: **maxback221** and **randomitem19**. Built on melonDS; matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, saves or firmware are bundled.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.4.0 — Experimental companions and flight preview
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.4.0

## New experimental options

Open **Launcher → Settings → Experimental**, enable the features you want, and restart the game. Both are off by default.

- **Companion interactions:** talk to, pet, and play with your lead Pokémon. Responses reflect its health and friendship. Click its following sprite or open **Unova → Pokémon → My companion**. Interactions do not change HP, friendship or your save.
- **Latias / Latios flight preview:** steer a pixel-art preview over your current surroundings. D-pad steers, L/R switches mount, and B returns. With HM02, the Fly button opens the original party screen; select a Pokémon and choose Fly to use the game’s own destinations.

The pause-menu entry is now **Unova**. Players, Pokémon, Co-op and Settings are sibling tabs; settings are no longer presented as part of Players.

## Setup

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract the complete portable ZIP. Update all players, restart the game, and follow the included player guide. No new ROM or save is required. Tailscale remains the fallback for different networks; the UDP bridge requires your own server.

## Known limits

The flight option is a menu preview, not free flight through a 3D Unova region. Native Fly retains its normal story restrictions, and completed Fly travel still needs gameplay testing. Companion interactions require a resolved idle field, and eggs cannot interact. In co-op, XP remains disabled to avoid desync. Keep fast-forward off during native wireless battles.

## Checks

The native ROM-backed menu fixture verifies opt-in gating, Talk/Pet/Play, battle safeguards, unchanged party/bag data, steering and mount switching, the native party shortcut, Options and existing menus. Compiled helper tests cover health/friendship responses, all 649 species and bounded steering. These checks do not establish full ORAS-style flight or completed Fly travel.

Made by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing. Playtesters: maxback221 and randomitem19. Built on melonDS; corresponding GPL source is included.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.13 — Direct menus and Options fix
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.13 — Direct menus and Options fix

- Switch directly between **Players**, **Pokémon**, **Co-op** and **Settings** using the bottom tabs or **L/R**. **B** or **Close** leaves any main page.
- Follower controls, the original **Game options** and **Trainer card** are on Settings. Ready/Busy and trainer battle mode are together on Co-op.
- Fixed the Options shortcut selecting the wrong native menu entry. An unavailable target now cancels safely instead of opening an unrelated screen.
- Removed the spectate controls.
- Checkpoint recovery now synchronizes wireless transport membership with the restored radio power state so retries do not retain stale membership.
- **maxback221** and **randomitem19** are credited as playtesters in the emulator and in a dedicated launcher strip that stays visible when resizing.

Use **Updates** in the launcher, or download **Unova-Together.exe** below. Save normally and close the emulator before replacing its build. No new ROM or save is required. Keep every player on the same version.

Native ROM-backed tests passed for direct navigation, B/Close, item-menu exit, Options, Trainer card, intentionally selecting the wrong native tile, and invalid-target cancellation. Launcher credits were checked at three window sizes. A two-process LAN test entered battle, cancelled back to the field, entered a second battle without restarting, and cancelled cleanly on both games. A powered-checkpoint test verified that transport membership is restored. Existing relay tests and retained story-result checks passed. This update does not add new battle or internet functionality; existing [beta limitations](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md) still apply.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Thank you to playtesters **maxback221** and **randomitem19**. Matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, saves or firmware are bundled.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.12 — Clearer menus and co-op tools
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.12 — Clearer menus and co-op tools

- **Back buttons fixed:** submenus now return to the correct parent.
- **Simpler menus:** open **Players → Tools**. Pokémon tools, co-op settings, game options and the trainer card now have separate entries.
- **Pokémon tools:** IVs/EVs, the encounter finder, move relearning and follower controls are together.
- **Co-op settings:** choose Solo or Co-op trainer battles before talking to an NPC. **Practice battles** are rematches with no story rewards; **PvP battle** challenges another player.
- **Battle previews:** select a teammate in Players, then use **Tools → Co-op → Watch teammate**. The battler must enable **Let friends watch**. Both screens appear in a separate window at two snapshots per second, with no remote controls or audio.
- **Followers:** show or hide your own follower or teammates' followers. Nearby followers can greet each other.
- **Teammate status:** clearer labels for menus, waiting for a partner, battle preparation and active battles.

Update **every player**, then restart the player-sharing relay using this version. Existing launcher users can use **Updates**; restart the emulator after updating. No new ROM or save is required. Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract the Windows ZIP and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**.

Previews are off by default. On slow connections, preview frames are dropped so they do not fill the status/interaction queue. Try the software renderer if a preview is blank or stale. Internet preview testing is still needed. Co-op battle experience remains disabled; other existing beta limitations are listed in [known issues](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

The native menu fixture, relay tests and story-return checks passed. A muted two-instance Cheren practice battle completed on both games at about 59–60 FPS. This does not verify every story award or internet connection. See the [co-op tools guide](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/COOP_TOOLS.md).

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. No ROMs, saves or firmware are bundled.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.11 - Field tools
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.11 — Field tools

- **Encounter finder:** browse the current area's encounters by season in **Players → Game**.
- **Relearn moves:** choose a level-up move and its replacement slot, then confirm. Relearning is free.
- **Field HMs:** keep the HM in your bag and a non-egg Pokémon in your party. You can use it without occupying a learned move slot. Interact with obstacles normally; choose Fly from the Pokémon menu.

Supports the reviewed English Black 2 routines, including Redux Complete v1.4.1. Original story requirements still apply. If all four of a Pokémon's moves already have field actions, choose another Pokémon for Fly.

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or extract the Windows ZIP and run **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Existing users can use **Updates** in the launcher. Restart the emulator after updating; no new ROM or save is required.

Encounter tables, learnsets, move replacement and all six HM eligibility paths passed focused checks. Native menus passed on a copied save, and Fly opened the original destination menu with JIT enabled. Full HM traversal, completed Fly travel and save/reload after relearning have not been playtested. Back up your save before trying these beta features.

The encounter finder excludes gifts, scripted legendary encounters and Hidden Grottos. Relearning offers the current species/form's level-up moves at or below its current level. See [field tools](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/FIELD_TOOLS.md) and [known issues](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.9 — Area battle scenery and followers
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.9

Save in game and close the emulator before updating. In the launcher, open **Updates → Check for updates** and install **0.3.9**, or download **Unova-Together.exe** below. Update everyone playing together. Back up your saves first.

## New and improved

- **Area battle scenery:** enable **Settings → Area battle scenery (experimental)** before launching. The launcher builds native 3D arenas using assets from your own English Black 2 ROM. The first launch prepares a local cache; subsequent launches reuse it. Turn the option off to restore standard backgrounds. Your ROM and save files are not edited.
- **Following Pokémon:** corrected follower identities and animation selection. Pokémon without native directional artwork use a party-icon fallback; not all species have complete walking sprites.
- **Game menus:** fixed the Options shortcut opening the player card.
- Includes the latest launcher and automatic restart after updates.

## Tested and known limits

The local Redux Complete v1.4.1 / Unova Together ROM generated **137 area scenes covering 617 map headers**. Every generated model passed parsing and resource-size checks. A two-emulator Cheren co-op battle displayed the new scenery, completed on both instances and returned to Ready at approximately **59–60 FPS**. Launcher cache generation/reuse and focused native menu checks passed.

Scenery remains experimental. These are generated arenas, not exact reconstructions of maps. Only standard battle-background resources are replaced; Pokéstar cinematic scenes remain original. Seasonal/time lighting and animated water are not implemented, and not every encounter has been playtested. Co-op EXP remains disabled. Keep C-Gear wireless and fast-forward off during co-op. Other connection and rendering limitations are listed in [Known issues](https://github.com/WhatWasMissing/Unova-Together/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

Download the single EXE for the bundled launcher and emulator, or use the portable ZIP. Matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are provided. ROMs, saves and firmware are not included. Scenery graphics are generated locally from your own ROM.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.8 — LAN lobbies and traded Pokémon
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.8

Download **Unova-Together.exe**, or use **Updates → Check for updates** in the launcher. Update everyone before starting a new LAN game. Your ROM, saves and profiles are kept separately.

## Changes

- LAN games started from the launcher now allow up to 16 connected players. Change the lobby size under Co-op → Advanced.
- The host can pair with a later guest instead of only the first player who joined. Other connected players do not interfere with readiness, battle packets or recovery.
- Fixed stale co-op invitations after cleanup and improved recovery when the selected partner disconnects.
- High-level traded Pokémon obey in supported English Black 2 and Redux builds.

## Playing together

Use Local LAN or Tailscale for larger lobbies. A co-op battle still has **the host and one guest**; guest-to-guest battles and battles with more than two human players are not supported. The experimental internet UDP bridge remains limited to two players.

Keep fast-forward and C-Gear wireless off. Co-op experience remains disabled. See [known issues](docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md) and [the lobby testing guide](docs/LAN_LOBBIES.md).

## Tested

Three local emulator instances connected, including pairing with the second guest. Native battle startup and checkpoint cancellation/recovery passed, with approximately 59–60 FPS during the measured battle. Matching results, mismatched results, partner changes and disconnect handling passed focused network tests. The obedience fix passed 728 ROM-backed cases across four local game builds.

Full NPC victory, badge awards and save persistence in a three-player lobby have not been verified. Cross-network testing of this larger-lobby change is still needed.

Made by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing. Matching modified melonDS and launcher source is included in the Source ZIP. No ROMs, firmware or player saves are bundled.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.7 — Live map tracking recovery
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.7

Save in game and close the emulator. In the launcher, open **Updates → Check for updates**, install **0.3.7**, and restart. Update every player: older clients can still send incorrect map IDs.

## Fixes

- Outdoor map tracking now uses the zone under your player. Cached entry IDs could previously leave nearby teammates on different maps.
- Fixed the confirmed tracking failure that left positions unresolved and battle status stuck after returning to the field.
- Stock menus preserve the current zone instead of reverting to the map entered earlier.
- Same-map labels remain available during battles and field rebuilding when the location is verified.
- Teammates can remain visible behind the custom in-game menus when the live field camera is valid. Party and summary screens still hide the gameplay overlay.

## Checks and limits

Both reported RAM captures now resolve to the same zone with valid adjacent positions and clear a stale battle flag. The complete outdoor zone grid matches the loaded ROM. Recorded battle entry/exit, stale menu-map, invalid-grid, sprite motion/rendering, native menu and 12 relay tests pass.

These checks do not prove that all multiplayer desyncs are eliminated. A fresh multi-device replay of the reported incident is still needed. Co-op EXP remains disabled, and connection, trainer-event and cleanup limitations remain in **Setup → Known issues**. Keep C-Gear wireless and fast-forward off during co-op.

Download **Unova-Together.exe** for the bundled launcher and emulator, or use the portable ZIP. Matching GPL source and SHA-256 checksums are included. ROMs, saves and firmware are not included.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.6 — Battle presence recovery
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.6

Save normally and close the game, then open **Updates → Check for updates** in the launcher. Install beta **0.3.6** and reopen the launcher. Update both players before testing. New players can download **Unova-Together.exe** below; the portable ZIP is also available.

## Fixed

- Battle presence can now clear after three confirmed field-map samples even while the player sprite is unresolved. Previously that recovery gap could keep the battle flag and pre-battle location visible to teammates.
- Retained position samples use current game state rather than leftover battle/menu flags.
- The player list shows **Unavailable** instead of **Other map** when your local position cannot be resolved.

This release also includes launcher 20261009.9: startup/manual GitHub guide refresh with offline copies, LAN Host/Join, remembered connections, Retry, report review, keyboard/controller navigation and the gameplay Features page.

## Testing

Compiled battle transition and missing-actor regressions pass. Existing before/battle/after/menu RAM captures classify correctly; the post-battle capture clears its battle flag. All 12 presence-relay tests pass. The latest reported two-player incident has not been reproduced from a fresh snapshot, so this fixes a verified recovery gap rather than claiming every stale-state issue is resolved.

After updating, finish a normal battle on each device and check that both return to **Ready** and **Same map**. Repeat with one player changing maps while the other is fighting. If status stays wrong, save RAM snapshots from both games before moving indoors or restarting.

Co-op EXP remains disabled. Internet UDP battle completion, some trainer events, native cleanup and reconnects still have beta limitations; read **Setup → Known issues**. Keep C-Gear wireless and fast-forward off for co-op.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. Matching GPL source and checksums are included. No ROMs, saves or firmware are included.

releases.name: Unova Together beta 0.3.5 · Launcher update
releases.body:
# Unova Together beta 0.3.5

Download **Unova-Together.exe** and open it. Alternatively, extract **Unova-Together-0.3.5-Windows-x64.zip** and open **Start Unova Together.cmd**. Choose your own matching Black 2/Redux ROM and select **Play**. Update both players and restart the player-sharing relay.

## Launcher update — 9 October 2026

Launcher revision **20261009.9** is included in this refreshed beta.

- Setup guides refresh from GitHub at startup, independently of game updates. Use Setup → Refresh guides to check again; saved copies remain available offline.
- Host or join a local LAN game from the launcher. Role and host address are remembered per profile.
- Clearer connection status and a Retry button. Save and close the game before retrying.
- A Pokémon-styled launcher, optional menu music, and a Features page with gameplay screenshots.
- Full emulator settings, working relay checks and local relay hosting.
- Report a problem creates a local, redacted ZIP for review; nothing is uploaded automatically.
- Keyboard and XInput controller navigation while the launcher has focus. Physical controller testing is still pending.
- Clearer in-game MENU indicator for teammates.

17 launcher UI checks and 11 service checks passed. Fresh installation and upgrade checks passed with existing emulator settings preserved. Two native instances paired through the launcher; this update does not establish internet battle reliability.

## New and improved

- A Windows launcher with official GitHub release checks and checksum-verified updates. Updates install beside the existing build and retain your emulator settings; ROMs and saves are not overwritten. The launcher does not need a separate Python installation.
- Give item works while the idle co-op observer is enabled and from the custom trade overlay.
- Better battle-status recovery: a returned field can clear the battle badge even if the camera projection is temporarily unavailable. Field rebuilds switch tracking to the current owned player object.
- Different starter choices can agree at verified rival encounters. Both players use the host's matching ROM enemy variant while retaining their own story event and save.
- Remote trainer sprites are suppressed on local stock menu screens. Your menu status remains available to teammates.
- Hardened native wireless input, player-list handling and compressed/truncated ROM loading.

## Before playing

Back up your saves. Turn C-Gear wireless and fast-forward off. Co-op EXP gain remains disabled to prevent desynchronisation. The bundled Tailscale installer and setup guide remain available; the UDP bridge is experimental and has no default public server.

Native cleanup can time out after completion and discard recovered battle progress. An immediate second co-op battle can also fail to reconnect. Let recovery return both games to the field, then recreate native LAN before retrying. Intermittent rendering issues and unverified trainer events remain listed in [known issues](docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). Testing details are in [release checks](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS_0.3.5.md); they do not establish every rival story/save branch or reliable internet UDP battle completion.

Made by **mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing**, built on melonDS. The matching GPL source download and checksums are included. ROMs, saves and firmware are not included.
